ombudsman.rules: The bank replies to a complaint within 15 business days (bank standard, confirm with the bank). After a decision that rejects the complaint in whole or in part, the customer can appeal to the bank's Kundombudsman and can file with ARN (Allmänna reklamationsnämnden) in writing within one year of the complaint. ARN decides within 90 days. ARN filing pace about 10 a week (confirm with the bank). Eligibility and risk only: LisN never predicts that a customer will file.
